name: Melbourne Cubing for Kids Sunday 2023
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbmMvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--563b893d4a4b6b9bb9771fe09170d083965c9e97/logo.png)![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) Speedcubing Australia will donate 50% of all registration fees from this competition to the [Exford Primary School] (http://www.exfordps.vic.edu.au/) to assist the children who were injured in the bus rollover accident in May 2023. The funds will contribute their ongoing support and rehabilitation requirements. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Wurundjeri people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
